concept: 阻塞与其他战术的组合
question_cn: 阻塞战术最常与哪种战术组合使用，产生最大威力？
question_en: Which tactic is most commonly combined with a blockade for maximum effect?

options.text_cn: 阻塞 + 引入：先阻塞对方逃跑格，再引入对方棋子到阻塞格被吃
options.text_en: Blockade + attraction: block an enemy escape square, then lure an enemy piece onto the blocking square to be captured

options.text_cn: 阻塞 + 将杀：先封锁国王逃跑格或堵住对方防守子，再用将杀组合收尾
options.text_en: Blockade + checkmate: block the king's escape square or restrain a defender, then finish with a mating combination

options.text_cn: 阻塞 + 穿透攻击：先阻塞再用象/后的斜线穿透
options.text_en: Blockade + X-ray attack: block first, then attack through the position with a bishop or queen

options.text_cn: 阻塞 + 升变：先阻塞对方兵，再推己方兵升变
options.text_en: Blockade + promotion: block an enemy pawn, then advance your own pawn to promote

explanation_cn: 阻塞最强的组合是「阻塞铺路→将杀收尾」：先用阻塞子占住国王某个逃跑格（或堵住守护者不让其移动），再从另一方向实施将杀。本质上阻塞是「前置动作」，真正的战术收益来自后续的将杀或得子。识别组合时要同时看「阻塞之后白方/黑方能做什么」。
explanation_en: A blockade is often the setup for checkmate: first occupy one of the king's escape squares or restrain a defender, then deliver mate from another direction. The blockade is the preparatory move; the decisive gain comes from the resulting checkmate or material win. When evaluating the combination, calculate what each side can do after the blocking move.
